# seba1rx/tabmanager

> PHP Composer package for per-tab `$_SESSION` isolation. Each browser tab gets its own UUIDv4; session data is namespaced under that UUID so tabs cannot bleed state into each other.

## Mental model

```
Browser tab A                 Browser tab B
sessionStorage: uuid-A        sessionStorage: uuid-B
     |                              |
X-TabManager-TabId: uuid-A    X-TabManager-TabId: uuid-B
     |                              |
     v                              v
$_SESSION['tabmanager']['tabs']['uuid-A']['data']
$_SESSION['tabmanager']['tabs']['uuid-B']['data']
```

The UUID lives in `sessionStorage` (per-tab, never shared). Every AJAX request sends it as a request header. PHP reads that header to route reads/writes to the correct session slot.

## Session data structure

```php
$_SESSION['tabmanager']['tabs'] = [
    '<uuid-v4>' => [
        'data'        => [],            // key-value store — arbitrary types
        'is_active'   => true,          // false after beforeunload fires
        'last_active' => 1234567890,    // unix timestamp, updated by heartbeat
    ],
];
```

Other `$_SESSION` keys are never touched.

## Installation

```bash
composer require seba1rx/tabmanager
```

Post-install script copies `seba1rx_tabmanagerclient.js` to the project root automatically. Serve it from there or move it to your assets directory.

## Integration checklist

1. Include and configure the JS client in HTML (before application scripts)
2. Await `TabManagerClient.ready` before reading `tab.id` or calling `getHeaders()`
3. Spread `TabManagerClient.getHeaders()` into every AJAX/fetch call
4. Call `new TabManager()` in PHP and use `set()`/`get()`
5. Ensure `/tabmanager/*` requests reach PHP (see framework router section)

## HTML: include the JS client

Set config globals **before** the script tag.

```html
<head>
    <script>
        // Required only if /tabmanager/* routes are unavailable (e.g. php -S without router):
        // window.TABMANAGER_HEARTBEAT_URL = '/heartbeat-tab.php';

        // Enable verbose JS logging in development:
        // window.TABMANAGER_DEBUG = true;
    </script>
    <script src="/seba1rx_tabmanagerclient.js"></script>
</head>
```

`init()` runs automatically on `DOMContentLoaded`. It:
- Reads or generates a UUID from `sessionStorage` key `unique-tab-id`
- Runs a `BroadcastChannel` ownership check (~80 ms) to detect duplicate tabs
- Sets cookie `TABMANAGER_TABID` (shared fallback — do not rely on it for isolation)
- POSTs to `/tabmanager/new-tab` to register the tab in PHP session
- Starts the heartbeat (30 s interval, pauses/resumes with Page Visibility API)
- Registers `beforeunload` to stop the heartbeat and POST to `/tabmanager/tab-close`

## JS: await TabManagerClient.ready

`init()` is async. Reading `tab.id` before it resolves returns `null`.

```js
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async () => {
    await TabManagerClient.ready;   // UUID is now confirmed and unique

    console.log(TabManagerClient.tab.id);   // safe from here
    // safe to call getHeaders() from here
});
```

## JS: spread headers into every AJAX call

```js
const res = await fetch('/your-endpoint', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        ...TabManagerClient.getHeaders(),   // adds X-TabManager-TabId: <uuid>
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(payload),
});
```

Calls that omit `getHeaders()` fall back to the shared cookie — all tabs share the same cookie value, so tab isolation breaks silently for those calls.

## PHP: set() and get()

```php
<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';  // bootstrap registers endpoints here

use Seba1rx\TabManager\TabManager;

$tm = new TabManager();

// Write to current tab's slot (resolves X-TabManager-TabId header automatically)
$tm->set('step', 3);
$tm->set('draft_id', $postId);

// Read back
$step    = $tm->get('step');                    // 3
$missing = $tm->get('none', 'default_value');   // 'default_value'
```

`set()` is a no-op if the tab has not been registered via `indexNewTab()`. It never auto-creates a session slot from an arbitrary header value.

## PHP class API

| Method | Signature | Behavior |
|--------|-----------|----------|
| `__construct` | `__construct()` | Starts session if not started; initializes `$_SESSION['tabmanager']` |
| `indexNewTab` | `indexNewTab(string $tabId): void` | Registers a tab; idempotent |
| `touchTab` | `touchTab(string $tabId): void` | Updates `last_active` and `is_active = true`; creates tab if absent |
| `set` | `set(string $key, mixed $value): void` | Writes to current tab's data slot; no-op if tab not registered |
| `get` | `get(string $key, mixed $default = null): mixed` | Reads from current tab's data slot; returns `$default` if absent |
| `destroyTabSession` | `destroyTabSession(string $tabId): void` | Removes the tab entry entirely; no-op if absent |
| `markInactiveTab` | `markInactiveTab(string $tabId): void` | Sets `is_active = false`; no-op if absent |
| `debug` | `debug(): array` | Returns summary of all tabs (`is_active`, `last_active` as `Y-m-d H:i:s`, `keys`, `size` bytes) |
| `getTabId` | `getTabId(): ?string` _(protected)_ | Header first, then cookie fallback |
| `getTabIdStrict` | `getTabIdStrict(): ?string` | Header only — no cookie fallback |
| `isValidTabId` | `static isValidTabId(string $id): bool` | Validates UUID v4 format |

## How set() resolves the tab

```
set($key, $value)
  └─ getTabId()
       ├─ $_SERVER['HTTP_X_TABMANAGER_TABID']  ← primary (per-request, per-tab)
       └─ $_COOKIE['TABMANAGER_TABID']          ← fallback (shared, unreliable for isolation)
```

If neither is present, `set()` does nothing. If the tab is not registered, `set()` also does nothing.

## JS client API

| Member | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `TabManagerClient.ready` | `Promise<void>` | Resolves when `init()` completes. Always await before using `tab.id` |
| `TabManagerClient.tab.id` | `string\|null` | Confirmed UUID. `null` until `ready` resolves |
| `TabManagerClient.getHeaders()` | `() => object` | Returns `{ 'X-TabManager-TabId': <uuid> }` |
| `TabManagerClient.heartbeat.send()` | `async () => void` | Sends one heartbeat POST |
| `TabManagerClient.heartbeat.start()` | `() => void` | Starts the interval (idempotent) |
| `TabManagerClient.heartbeat.stop()` | `() => void` | Clears the interval |

## JS configuration globals (set before the script tag)

| Variable | Default | Effect |
|----------|---------|--------|
| `window.TABMANAGER_DEBUG` | `false` | Enables `console.log` tracing |
| `window.TABMANAGER_HEARTBEAT_URL` | `'/tabmanager/heartbeat'` | Override heartbeat endpoint |
| `window.TABMANAGER_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL` | `30000` | Heartbeat interval in milliseconds |

## HTTP endpoints (auto-registered by bootstrap)

| Method | Path | Called by | Description |
|--------|------|-----------|-------------|
| `POST` | `/tabmanager/new-tab` | JS `notifyNewTab()` | Registers tab; body: `{ "tab_id": "<uuid>" }` |
| `POST` | `/tabmanager/heartbeat` | JS `heartbeat.send()` | Touches tab; reads `X-TabManager-TabId` header |
| `POST` | `/tabmanager/tab-close` | JS `notifyTabClosed()` via `sendBeacon` | Marks tab inactive; body: `{ "tab_id": "<uuid>" }` |
| `GET` | `/tabmanager/debug_js` | Dev tools | JSON dump of all tab sessions |
| `GET` | `/tabmanager/debug_html` | Dev tools | HTML table of all tab sessions |
| `POST` | `/tabmanager/debug/delete-tab` | Debug UI | Destroys one tab's session entry |

Bootstrap intercepts matching URIs and calls `exit` — these requests never reach the application router.

## Framework and SPA router considerations

Bootstrap intercepts at the PHP level, before any framework router runs.

- **Laravel / Symfony / Slim / plain PHP front-controller:** works automatically. No extra config.
- **SPA with its own JS router:** the backend is still a PHP front-controller — works automatically.
- **`php -S` without a router script:** built-in server only serves real files; `/tabmanager/*` returns 404.

`php -S` workaround — create a physical PHP file and override the heartbeat URL:

```php
<?php // heartbeat-tab.php
require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';
$tabId = $_SERVER['HTTP_X_TABMANAGER_TABID'] ?? null;
if ($tabId) {
    $tm = new Seba1rx\TabManager\TabManager();
    $tm->touchTab($tabId);
}
http_response_code(204);
```

```html
<script>window.TABMANAGER_HEARTBEAT_URL = '/heartbeat-tab.php';</script>
```

## Security rules

**Never set `TABMANAGER_DEBUG` in production.** The constant is the only access gate for debug endpoints. There is no IP-based fallback.

```php
// DEV ONLY
define('TABMANAGER_DEBUG', true);
require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';
```

**Use `getTabIdStrict()` for sensitive endpoints.** It returns only the header value — no shared-cookie fallback.

```php
$tabId = $tm->getTabIdStrict();
if (!$tabId) { http_response_code(400); exit; }
```

**Session fixation is the application's responsibility.** This package does not call `session_regenerate_id()`. Call it on login and privilege escalation.

**`set()` blocks implicit slot creation.** A forged header for an unregistered UUID is silently ignored.

## Duplicate-tab detection

When a tab is duplicated the browser copies `sessionStorage`, so both tabs would share the same UUID. On `init()` the JS client broadcasts an `ownership-query` on `BroadcastChannel('tabmanager-ownership')` and waits 80 ms. If the original tab responds with `ownership-ack`, the duplicate generates a fresh UUID.

Known limitation: if the original tab is frozen by the browser (Chrome Memory Saver / tab suspension) its JS is paused and cannot respond. The duplicate keeps the UUID.

## Heartbeat lifecycle

```
tab visible      → heartbeat.start() (interval every 30 s)
tab hidden       → heartbeat.stop()
tab visible again → heartbeat.send() immediately + heartbeat.start()
beforeunload     → heartbeat.stop() + notifyTabClosed() via sendBeacon
```

Server side: `touchTab($tabId)` updates `last_active` and sets `is_active = true`. Creates the tab if not yet indexed.

## Common mistakes

| Mistake | Consequence | Fix |
|---------|-------------|-----|
| Reading `tab.id` before `await TabManagerClient.ready` | Gets `null`; requests fail silently | Always await `TabManagerClient.ready` first |
| Omitting `...TabManagerClient.getHeaders()` in a fetch | Cookie fallback used; all tabs share same slot | Always spread headers into every request |
| Calling `$tm->set()` before the tab is registered | Silent no-op; data not stored | JS client registers automatically; for custom flows call `indexNewTab($tabId)` explicitly |
| `TABMANAGER_DEBUG = true` in production | Debug endpoints exposed to any user | Remove before deploy |
| Using page-load requests for tab-isolated data | Cookie is shared — wrong tab may be identified | Only isolate data from AJAX calls that include `getHeaders()` |
| `php -S` without a router and no custom heartbeat file | Heartbeat 404s; `last_active` stale | Set `window.TABMANAGER_HEARTBEAT_URL` to a physical PHP file |

## Minimal working example

**`index.html`**
```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <script src="/seba1rx_tabmanagerclient.js"></script>
    <script src="/app.js" defer></script>
</head>
<body>
    <p>Tab: <span id="tab-id">…</span></p>
    <button id="save">Save data</button>
</body>
</html>
```

**`app.js`**
```js
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async () => {
    await TabManagerClient.ready;

    document.getElementById('tab-id').textContent = TabManagerClient.tab.id;

    document.getElementById('save').addEventListener('click', async () => {
        await fetch('/save.php', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                ...TabManagerClient.getHeaders(),
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({ value: 'hello from this tab' }),
        });
    });
});
```

**`save.php`**
```php
<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

$tm = new Seba1rx\TabManager\TabManager();
$body = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);

$tm->set('saved_value', $body['value'] ?? null);

header('Content-Type: application/json');
echo json_encode(['ok' => true]);
```

## Testing

```bash
composer test
```

49 tests, 68 assertions. All public methods of `TabManager` are covered. Tests use a null session save handler — no files written to disk, fully isolated.

```php
// tests/bootstrap.php pattern
session_set_save_handler(
    open:    fn(string $path, string $name): bool => true,
    close:   fn(): bool => true,
    read:    fn(string $id): string => '',
    write:   fn(string $id, string $data): bool => true,
    destroy: fn(string $id): bool => true,
    gc:      fn(int $max_lifetime): int|false => 0,
);
session_start();
```
